notes.title: The Clarity Update for Super Flippin' Phones, live now
notes.content:
[i]Today we're presenting an update to Super Flippin' Phones that's a bit bigger than the last patch, so we gave it a nice name! This update has two goals: provide existing fans and players with more clarity about unlocking mechanics and goal names, and make it easier for new players to get acquainted with the game.[/i]

[b]Unwrapping Costumes[/b]
We noticed our costume gifts were too subtle and often went unnoticed -- gifts are now 110% more fun *and* way harder to miss. We'll let this speak for itself:[url=http://i.imgur.com/OOiQnvl.gif][img]http://i.imgur.com/OOiQnvl.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Goals[/b]
We got a lot of questions about the goals to unlock new floors and Tiers. Since the achievement stats reflected that a lot of the content was left untouched, we decided to make some goal descriptions a tad less cryptic. We hope you like them!

[b]Unlocking Tiers[/b]
In SFP, you can unlock difficulty tiers, costumes and new floors. All these behave slightly different when unlocked: new floors are always added to the floor pool, but new Tiers needed to be switched to manually. We've changed this; you now automatically switch to a Tier once you unlock it (the Replay button changes to 'Next Tier')

[b]The tutorial[/b]
A dreaded part of most games, we felt that some of our messages weren't really necessary. We filtered them down to things we feel need explaining, and made others into button prompts.[url=http://i.imgur.com/QHdv6LN.gif][img]http://i.imgur.com/QHdv6LN.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Fonts[/b]
Some of the in-game fonts were rendering badly (W's, N's and M's became H's) so we replaced the font for [url=https://managore.itch.io/]Daniel Linssen's[/url] new [b]m5x7 font[/b], which is an improvement on all f(r)onts.

[b]The volume[/b]
We lowered it!

[b]Plus these smaller changes:[/b][list][*]The game now warns you when pressing Escape or Start before quitting the match[/*][*]More hints about where you can switch costumes in the game[/*][*]The Unlockables button is now called Progress and has a percentage[/*][*]Fixed rare crashes when pressing Start during a game[/*][*]Fixed dangers from being in the screen the whole time (yes, that was a bug)[/*][*]The other mall layouts now have their own floor tiles so they are more recognizable[/*][/list]

The Clarity Update is live right now with build number 1046274.

We hope you enjoy it -- let us know what you think in the comments!

notes.title: Super Flippin' Phones: Screw the Scammer Giveaway
notes.content:
We sent Steam keys to a scammer and because they may still be unclaimed, we're hosting a giveaway to redistribute them. Help us stop this scammer and maybe get a free copy!

Sharing would be hugely appreciated!

To enter the giveaway, go to [url=http://gvwy.io/zad436g]our Facebook page[/url] (weird link but it really goes there)!

[img]http://superflippinphones.com/img/giveaway.gif[/img]

notes.title: Super Flippin' Phones Patch #1 (build 990154)
notes.content:
We just updated Super Flippin' Phones, fixing some small bugs and clearing some interface designs and challenges up.

We're very happy with what we're hearing up to now -- please let us know if you have encountered other bugs or anomalies!

Full patch notes:
[list]
[*]Cursor now hides while in-game, and in the menu if a gamepad is connected
[*]The game no longer tells you to 'tap' things
[*]Highscores now refresh when you change filter
[*]Fixed an issue with no button being highlighted in the score overview
[*]Fixed an issue with costume unlocking
[*]Made some goal descriptions for Tier unlocking clearer[/list]
